question: V100-SXM2-16GB 的 HBM2 显存带宽为 900 GB/s，是 Qwen3.8-27B (NVFP4) 推理的主要瓶颈。在 Memory-Bound 场景下，理论最大生成速度约为 Bandwidth / Model_Size = 900GB/s / 6.75GB ≈ 133 tokens/s (单卡等效)，TP=4 并行下受限于 AllReduce 通信开销，实际集群吞吐上限约为 100-120 tokens/s，而非计算力决定的 2000+ tokens/s。

sources.snippet: The Tesla V100 SXM2 16 GB was a data center GPU by NVIDIA, launched on June 21st, 2017. Built on the 12 nm process, and based on the GV100 graphics processor, the GPU supports DirectX 12.
